id: # renderprec: found while gating the render precision merge on the dev host

cause: the device mesher (cuda/mesh) fails on the dev host's RTX 3090 (sm_86) with an illegal memory access (cumesh: join, cumesh: draw) on master b1e35ce2 and on the merge base 25876549, even with groups of 1 env a stream; cuda-mesh-check pix-fluid-s1 meshes nothing (render_check --seq dies); the same gates passed on the GPU host (sm_120); maybe the cause of perfhost-cumesh-null. Cause (lane/meshcrash): ptxas spilled convergence barriers around the draw calls into the render tree; lanes returning first restored them while others still used them, so the draw kernels left the draw split and lane_end, compiled for a whole warp, read the mesher address from a uniform register another lane group had overwritten (memcheck: rec_state meshdev.c:311 from lane_end, 0x...00000040); only the ptxas -O1 build (PERF=0) crashed
pin: make -C csrc cuda-mesh-check PERF=0 (93 recordings, pix-fluid-s1 among them); explore stress at PERF=0
repro: CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 make -s -C csrc/runtime pipe-gate MESH=2 DRAW=1 GROUP=1 (on the dev host); make -s -C csrc cuda-mesh-check MESH_ARGS=pix-fluid-s1
